title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits Chart: Award-Stay Night Crediting by Tier
content:
On an Ashbury Rewards award stay — a completed Reward Night Rate stay — the credits for the nights stayed depend on the tier the membership holds. The nights stayed on the award stay are the whole calendar days from its actual check-in date to its actual check-out date.

## Chart

| Tier the membership holds | Credits for the nights stayed on an award stay |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | One night credit for every two nights stayed, an odd last night earning nothing |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | One night credit for every two nights stayed, an odd last night earning nothing |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | No award-stay crediting under this chart |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | No award-stay crediting under this chart |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | The tier's night credit for each night stayed plus one further credit for the award stay |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | The tier's night credit for each night stayed plus one further credit for the award stay |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Member or Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite receives one night credit for every two nights stayed, an odd last night earning nothing; a member at Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite receives the tier's night credit for each night stayed plus one further credit for the award stay. The further credit of the top tiers is 1 per award stay, whatever its length, and the base and Silver tiers earn 1 credit per 2 nights stayed.

The further credit of Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite is a credit the award stay is owed; it is never an excess over the stay's nights stayed.

## Worked figures (hypothetical award stays)

| Tier | Actual check-in | Actual check-out | Nights stayed | Credits for the nights stayed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Silver Elite | 3 May | 8 May | 5 | 2 — two pairs of nights; the odd fifth night earns nothing |
| Member | 3 May | 4 May | 1 | 0 |
| Silver Elite | 3 May | 9 May | 6 | 3 |
| Titanium Elite, tier's night credit taken as 1 | 3 May | 6 May | 3 | 3 for the nights plus 1 further credit, 4 in all |
| Ambassador Elite, tier's night credit taken as 1 | 3 May | 4 May | 1 | 1 plus 1, 2 in all |
